name: Ben-hadad
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Instead of crying to the Most High as he did against Zerah, Asa takes silver and gold out of the house of the Lord and the king's house and hires Benhadad king of Syria to break his league with Baasha.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 16: Asa Leans on Syria Instead of the Most High

points: Her young men shall fall in her streets and a fire in the wall of Damascus shall consume the palaces of Benhadad: what the Bible records historically recurs, and the new president of Syria is the terror network's emir with a haircut, allied with a list of designated jihadist groups.

note.label: Zionism in the Face of Syria & Hezbollah

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
